news.title: ‘It’s not in us’: Anthony Gordon backs Tuchel over England’s possession problem
news.lede: Barcelona winger says England cannot play like Spain. Gordon: players ‘could have done more’ in semi-final. Anthony Gordon has sided with Thomas Tuchel’s assertion that controlling games through possession is not part of English football’s DNA. Although Gordon revealed surprise at being substituted when England were 1-0 up in their World Cup semi-final against Argentina, the winger refused to blame the defeat on Tuchel’s decisions and argued that wider cultural issues influenced the side’s collapse.

news.title: Vinícius Júnior et al land in unlikely outpost of Townsville as Brazil reboot begins | Joey Lynch
news.lede: The Seleção’s rebuild after their latest World Cup exit begins against the Socceroos in a place better known for rugby league than joga bonito. It’s a safe bet that Vinícius Júnior, who plays week in and week out for Real Madrid at the Santiago Bernabéu, doesn’t know about North Queensland Fury. Indeed, it is likely that none of the Brazil side that landed in Townsville on Thursday are aware of Australian football’s history in the region. Nor, perhaps, the city itself, until recently.

news.title: UAE opens Gulf Cup 27 with 4-0 win over Yemen
news.lede: Dubai: The United Arab Emirates made a flying start to their 27th Arabian Gulf Cup campaign, beating Yemen 4-0 in their opening Group B match in Alinma Stadium, Jeddah on Thursday.Nicolas Gimenez opened the scoring in the 26th minute before Yemen defender Nader Sahal put the ball into his own net 10 minutes later. The UAE continued to control the match and added a third goal before half-time through Luan Pereira.Gimenez completed his brace six minutes into the second half, putting the UAE firmly in control and sealing a comfortable opening victory. The midfielder’s two goals also provided a strong start to the tournament for the team under new coach Zlatko Dalic.The UAE dominated possession with 61 per cent of the ball and registered 12 shots during the match.

news.title: All Whites draw with Palestine after twice taking lead
news.lede: The All Whites have drawn 2-2 with Palestine in the first match following their Fifa World Cup group exit. Darren Bazeley’s side twice gave up the lead in the first half against the side ranked nine places below them on the Fifa rankings. In the first of four matches in this September/October Fifa window, it was a completely different line-up to the one that lost 5-1 to Belgium in Vancouver with three new names taking the field at Tongliang Long Stadium in Chongqing, China. George Stanger, who has previously been part of All Whites squads but had never taken to the field, was named to make his debut, while Michael Woud, fresh from a title-winning season with Auckland FC, started in goal for the All Whites for the first time since November 2023.
